info.title: DealFlow API
info.description: DealFlow by Sampledge, REST API v1.

get.summary: Command Center KPIs from live data (dashboard:read)
Possible duplicates by email, phone or name and company (leads:read)

post.summary: Merge a duplicate into this lead (leads:write)
Convert into contact, company and deal (leads, contacts, companies, deals:write)
Move to another stage; Lost needs a reason (deals:write)
Reassign or move up to 200 deals (deals:write)
Log a call, email, meeting or note (activities:write)

get.summary: Search records the caller can read
Fields a CSV column can map to

post.summary: Import CSV, with dry run and duplicate skipping (<entity>:write)
Invite by email; returns the link once — email delivery is not configured (members:manage)
Accept; existing accounts confirm their password
Dry run against a record; nothing is written (automation:manage)

get.summary: The caller's notifications and unread count

post.summary: Mark some or all as read
Create; returns the signing secret once (integrations:manage)

patch.summary: Change URL or events, or switch on and off (integrations:manage)

get.summary: Provider set-up and the caller's connections (activities:read)

post.summary: Start OAuth; 409 when the provider is not configured (activities:write)

200.description: Counts of new emails and meetings

get.summary: Synced and sent email linked to records (activities:read)

post.summary: Send one email from the caller's mailbox; daily cap applies (activities:write)
